title: 6-DoF Robot Arm with Imitation Learning
description: Built a LeRobot SO-101 arm, recorded 50+ teleoperated demos, and trained an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) policy that does pick-and-place on the real hardware.

title: Autonomous RC Car (DSC 190)
description: Trained a behavioral cloning model and deployed it to a Raspberry Pi 5 on a physical car, then wrote a lighting-robust line follower with cone-stop and reverse-on-lost behaviors.

title: Parkinson's Medication-State EEG Classifier
description: Cross-subject classifier that predicts levodopa ON/OFF state from resting-state EEG, evaluated with leave-one-subject-out validation and a permutation null.

title: ECG Analog Front-End
description: Built an AD620-based amplifier circuit with an Arduino and a Python pipeline to capture, filter, and analyze live ECG.

title: Data-Driven Projects and GitHub Stats (DSC 106 Lab 4)
description: Moved my project data into a JSON file, rendered it with a reusable JavaScript function, and pulled live stats from the GitHub API.

title: Dynamic Nav and Dark Mode (DSC 106 Lab 3)
description: Built the site nav in JavaScript with automatic current-page highlighting, plus a light/dark theme switch that remembers your choice.

title: Styling the Portfolio with CSS (DSC 106 Lab 2)
description: Styled the site with a flexbox nav, an accent color, a grid-based contact form, and a structured CV page.

title: Portfolio Website in HTML (DSC 106 Lab 1)
description: Built the first version of this site: a multi-page layout with a home page, projects, CV, and a contact form.
